When `embed_category` is blank (the default, ''), the site_settings row either doesn't exist or doesn't match a category name, so the result set is empty and `[0]` is nil, raising NoMethodError before the `if category_id == 0` fallback can run — aborting the migration and preventing the embeddable_hosts data migration and site_settings cleanup that follow.
